notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 - Release Notes
notes.content:
Balance & Adjustments

 Added an option to display or hide the HP bar.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/641745a7649b1a2fa4f4d8c938d5a653ec39a4a9.png
 Reduced mana consumption rate for smoother gameplay.
 Adjusted matching gesture score system for better accuracy.
 All shop items now cost 20% less.
 Various bug fixes and stability improvements.


New Content

 Added new gesture symbols for more dynamic spellcasting.
 New Spell: Cyclone Surge – Unleash a swirling vortex of magic to devastate enemies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/8b9587c768dceb8dd9094d11e9cdc718fdc0b2c4.png

 New Boss: Inferna – Face the fiery wrath of the new boss in the arena of flames!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/0bc6c9d215ebde3c6368b7c105bfeb5f747ccf31.png


 Boss Leaderboard: Compete with others and rise to the top by defeating bosses as quickly and efficiently as possible!

notes.title: Thailand International Game Showcase 2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/ee2dc67563302d865e16e69c61dfac5c6111efe8.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/b71100c200cc148d631f0408ca1a2982e0614f1e.png

About the event
From August 30 to September 1, 2024, we participated in a three-day event featuring over 30 games created by Thai developers. Magic Caster and I were honoured to be among the exhibitors. The event was an incredible experience, attracting numerous visitors who provided valuable feedback on my game. As the developer, I want to express my heartfelt thanks for your support. Rest assured, improvements and new content for Magic Caster are still on the way!


Bosses battle event
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/2db675000283d5523a272cba82859bdb86f47fcc.png

I was thrilled to watch players take on the bosses at the event. Here's a breakdown of their performances:
 ArrowWraith: 1 Win, 49 Losses
 NecroCaster: 0 Wins, 43 Losses
 UndeadKing: 5 Wins, 74 Losses
 DarkWizard: Still locked (No wins against NecroCaster yet)


The challenges were intense, and the excitement was palpable. Can't wait to see who will unlock the DarkWizard!

notes.title: Updated 1.1.1
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed red indicator still appearing after a monster's death.
 Fixed Healing spell ability UI showing the wrong indicator.


Balancing:

 Removed Z and Triangle gestures for smoother gameplay.
 ArrowWraith: Increased cooldown before attacking.
 Adjusted mana consumption rate.
 Adjusted monster spawn rate in campaign mode.


Contents:
Currently, over 50 players compete on the leaderboard, all striving to climb to the top. Join us in the Leaderboard Challenge!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44890655/8e30e0031ecfacd962d0f7df758db77b16da6e30.png

Next Update:
Stay tuned for new bosses with super challenges.

PS: Tomorrow, Magic Caster is 30% off!

notes.title: Magic Caster is available!
notes.content:
Hey Magic Casters!

I’m incredibly excited to announce the official release of Magic Caster! The time has come, and I think this is the perfect moment to publish my first game. It's been over a year since I started working on this project, and I can’t believe it’s finally complete. Although I’m a solo developer, I’ve had the support and advice of some amazing friends and fellow game developers. It's a tear in my eye.

Features and Content:

 4 bosses to defeat
 10 levels of campaign mode
 1 Endless mode with leaderboard
 10+ achievements to unlock
 More spells, pets, and wands to discover
 Face a variety of monsters (they’re out to get you!)


Ongoing Development and Support:
I want to assure you that my journey doesn't stop here, even if you’ve already bought the game. I’m dedicated to continuously improving the game, adding more content, and fixing any issues based on your feedback.

Join the Magic Caster Community:

 Discord
 TikTok
 Youtube
 X(Twitter)


Thank you for being a part of my first game and my journey. Get ready to embark on the magical adventure of a lifetime with Magic Caster! Have fun!

Thank you so much, Teerawat Samansook - LavaLittleBird

notes.title: Magic Caster in TGA
notes.content:
Get ready for the fun of Magic Caster in different ways:


 Play by yourself with just your mouse.
 Take on adventures solo using your stylus.
 Team up with a friend for a cool twist; one move and the other battles monsters by drawing.


Magic Caster comes to life at gaming events. You'll dive deep into its world, finding tons of ways to win. These events are super fun and full of thrills and teamwork.
